articles.summary: 这篇文章报道西班牙政府改变此前立场，同意将滞留休达的500名无人陪伴移民儿童送往本土。尽管大多数越境者已返回摩洛哥，但西班牙法律要求国家照顾未成年移民直至成人，政策转向反映法律与人道压力。值得阅读是因为它展示了欧洲移民治理的复杂性和国家义务的实践。

articles.sourceExcerpt: The summer I turned sixteen, I took a bus across Bulgaria — I suppose you could call it running away, though my parents were aware and unconcerned — to go sit on the edge of the Black Sea and watch the blue horizon, to touch its infinite loneliness and infinite happiness. Albert Camus (November 7, 1913–January 4, 1960)… read article

zh.title: 架构优先的系统设计：双语教程、模板与端到端案例集
zh.highlight: 26个双语教程、25个架构模板、6个端到端案例，覆盖分布式系统、AI原生系统、RAG、编码Agent及生产权衡。
zh.summary: 这是一个以架构优先理念整理的系统设计资源仓库，包含大量双语教程、架构模板和端到端案例，内容覆盖分布式系统、AI原生系统、RAG、编码Agent等前沿方向。该仓库兼顾理论框架与工程权衡，适合希望从全局视角构建复杂系统的开发者和架构师阅读，能帮助快速建立技术选型与设计直觉。
zh.failureAnalysis: 该项目作为GitHub资源库，可能因内容维护不及时而逐渐过时，尤其是AI原生系统和RAG相关技术迭代极快，教程中的示例可能很快失效。此外，架构模板和案例多为通用性总结，缺少真实业务场景的数据支撑，读者在落地时可能遇到难以调和的细节冲突。若缺乏社区互动和持续更新，其价值容易被其他更活跃的同类仓库稀释。

en.highlight: 26 bilingual tutorials, 25 architecture templates, and 6 end-to-end cases covering distributed systems, AI-native systems, RAG, coding Agents, and production trade-offs.
en.summary: This is a curated repository of system design resources organized around an architecture-first mindset, featuring bilingual tutorials, architecture templates, and end-to-end cases spanning distributed systems, AI-native systems, RAG, coding agents, and production trade-offs. It is valuable for developers and architects who want a broad yet practical view of building complex systems, helping them build intuition for technology selection and design decisions.
en.failureAnalysis: As a GitHub repository, it may become outdated if not actively maintained, especially since AI-native systems and RAG evolve quickly and examples can become obsolete. Its generic templates and cases lack data from real business scenarios, so practitioners may struggle with detailed conflicts during implementation; without community engagement and continuous updates, it risks being overshadowed by more active repositories.
en.title: Architecture-First System Design: Bilingual Tutorials, Templates, and End-to-End Cases
